metadata.selection: 5-fold 30m geographic blocks, 10m buffer; lap 1 only; minimum MAE on identical support
metadata.flagged_tuple_policy: primary excludes joint -44/-3/-113, not every -44; raw dataset retains all
metadata.caveats: Single-device single-session LTE band 1 serving-cell observations. Does not identify transmitter geometry or counterfactual handover outcomes.
metadata.neighbor_identity_assumption: Neighbours without PLMN use the serving PLMN as an explicit assumption; a unique PCI/channel binding is not independently verified neighbour identity.
metadata.purpose: Neighbour-augmented sensitivity; same frozen lap-1-selected parameters; no lap-2 fitting

semantics: Empirical conditional serving-cell RSRP, not a complete network radio field; missing predictions mean unsupported.
uncertainty: local_spread_db is neighbor-value dispersion, not a calibrated prediction interval.
